name: @dingji_cherubino/dsh-full-featured-hub
description: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin: ONE extensible HUD card above the composer that hosts many panels behind a tab strip. Ships with two: subscription quota (OpenCode GO, DeepSeek, GLM, Kimi, Grok, MiMo, OpenRouter, SiliconFlow, Qwen Token Plan, Command Code, custom JSON endpoints, in-card credential drawer, 30-day usage chart) and GitHub activity (device-flow sign-in, your own repos, releases/pushes/branches/merges/issues). Every panel keeps its own host routes and its own polling, so all of them stay live at the same time; adding a panel is one file plus one registry line.

scripts.test: node tools/test-host.mjs && node tools/test-client.mjs && node tools/test-config.mjs && node tools/check-utf8.mjs && node tools/check-jsx.mjs && node tools/check-tdz.mjs && node tools/build-client.mjs --check
